changelog.title: What changed, in order.
changelog.lede: Every visible change we have made to this corporate site, dated and tied to the commit behind it. Each product in the Clap ecosystem keeps its own changelog on its own domain — this page is the parent-company front door, nothing more, nothing hidden.

roadmap.title: What we are building.
roadmap.lede: In public. No vaporware. Every item is on the studio side — corporate-site work, shared infrastructure, and the cross-cutting commitments that touch every product. Each product in the Clap ecosystem keeps its own roadmap on its own domain. Items here link to code when they ship.
roadmap.emptyColumn: Nothing in this column right now. New work appears here as it moves stages.
roadmap.ctaBody: If there is a feature, tool, or fix that would make a real difference to you, send us a note. We read every message and prioritise based on real need.

insights.eyebrow: INSIGHTS · FIELD NOTES FROM THE STUDIO
insights.title: Thinking in public.
insights.lede: Field notes on universal access, AI-augmented engineering, the offline 2.2 billion, and the long arc of artificial intelligence — written to be understood, not to impress. We write slowly. Every claim links to a source. No clickbait, no thought-leadership fog.

trust.title: Where to find the proof.
trust.lede: Every claim we make about security, privacy, sustainability, and access links to the evidence. You should never have to take our word for it.
trust.certsEmpty: None yet. When we are certified, it will show up here with a link to the evidence.
trust.certsEmptyBody: We are a small studio. Formal certifications are expensive and slow. When we earn one it will appear here with a link to the issuer.
trust.subprocessorsLede: Every third party that may touch your data, what they access, and where they operate.
trust.incidentHeading: Found something? Please tell us first.
trust.incidentBody: Coordinated disclosure is the path we take seriously. Email security@intelligentsingularityinc.com with a description and reproduction steps. We acknowledge reports within one business day, triage within three, and ship a fix on a timeline we agree with you. Researchers are credited by name in our post-mortem when a fix ships — unless you prefer to remain anonymous. We do not threaten or sue good-faith security researchers, full stop.

help.title: We can usually help in one click.
help.lede: Pick the row that sounds most like your question. Every link goes somewhere real — no gated forms, no chatbots.

about.ecosystemHeading: One parent company, seven product categories.
about.talkToStudioBody: Partnerships, press, or a product question — messages reach the founder directly, typically within two business days.

manifesto.offlinePercentHeading: Two-point-two billion people are still offline today.
manifesto.offlinePercentBody: The lighter dots above are the people already online. The darker, ringed dots are the people who are not. Ninety-six percent of the offline population lives in low- and middle-income countries. Universal-access engineering is what closes that gap. The nine commitments below are how we hold ourselves to it.
manifesto.commitmentsBody: Nine concentric rings — every product ships against every one of them, every release. The list is not a wishlist. It is the engineering contract.

pricing.sixRulesHeading: Six rules every product ships under
pricing.antiPatternsBody: The anti-patterns below are common in business software. We have decided against each of them, in writing, in advance — so neither we nor a future us can quietly bring them back.
pricing.workedExampleBody: A worked example — illustrative, not a price quote — to show how the six rules play out in practice. Specific numbers live on each product’s own page.

careers.whatYouWouldWorkOnHeading: What you would actually work on
careers.howWeHireHeading: How we hire, end to end
careers.whatYouWouldWorkOnLede: Intelligent Singularity is the parent company of a growing family of platforms. New hires rarely work on a single product for an entire year — most cycle across two or three, depending on what is shipping and what needs the most senior attention that quarter.
careers.howWeHireLede: Four steps. Maximum two weeks from first email to written offer if both sides move quickly. No surprise stages, no unpaid take-homes, no "culture fit" rejections without a written reason.

press.boilerplateLede: One paragraph, drop-in for press releases. Approved for verbatim use.
press.storyAnglesYesLede: If your story sits inside one of these angles, we will move quickly to make a founder, an engineer, or a product lead available — usually within a working day.
press.storyAnglesNoLede: Honesty up front saves everyone time. We will not provide quotes for the angles below. We will, however, point you to a journalist or analyst whose work fits the story better.

portfolio.lede: Intelligent Singularity is the parent company of the Clap ecosystem. Every product runs on its own domain, under its own terms, with its own pricing — but they share one engineering stack, one accessibility budget, one privacy posture, and one shared AI-agent fabric. Honest status labels throughout: production, staging, awaiting approval, infrastructure.

contact.responseTimeBody: A human reads every message. We reply within two business days across UTC−07:00 (Mountain) working hours. Security and legal inquiries are prioritised — security reports are acknowledged within one business day. We can reply in any of the fourteen languages this site speaks.

security.postureHeading: How we run the site and the platform
security.complianceLede: We follow a small, named set of standards — and we are honest about which audits we have not yet earned.

green.statThirdPartyHint: No pixels · no fonts · no CDN
green.byteBudgetHeading: How the byte budget stays small
green.pledgeHeading: We publish everything. You hold us accountable.
green.pledgeBody: Every number on this page is computed live from real measurements. The bundle budget is enforced by CI; the third-party count is audited on every build; the carbon estimate uses Green Web Foundation methodology against the page weight you actually loaded. If something looks wrong, tell us — we will respond in writing within five business days, with the underlying numbers shown.

bundleBudget.label: Bundle budget
bundleBudget.hint: Gzipped. Enforced by CI on every pull request — a build that breaks the budget cannot ship.

thirdPartyCalls.label: Third-party calls
thirdPartyCalls.hint: No analytics, fonts, pixels, video embeds, social widgets, or CDN round-trips. Audited per build by no-third-party.mjs.

renderer.label: Renderer
renderer.hint: Pages render on the server and stream to the browser. Hydration is opt-in, per-component, never global.

mediaStrategy.label: Media strategy
mediaStrategy.hint: No raster heroes. Inline SVG illustrations. Per-script font subsets loaded only when that script is on the page.

hosting.label: Hosting
hosting.hint: Self-hosted on a single VPS in Edmonton, Alberta. No CDN. No edge nodes. One origin, one trust boundary.

offlineReach.label: Offline reach
offlineReach.hint: Network-first HTML · stale-while-revalidate assets · offline fallback page on every locale.

reducedMotion.label: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.hint: Every animation pauses when prefers-reduced-motion is set. No exceptions, no opt-outs needed.

paperless.label: Paperless by default
paperless.hint: Invoices, medical records, receipts default to digital. Office paper, business cards, and printed marketing collateral are not part of how we operate.

common.offlineBody: Universal access is the brief. This site keeps working without a connection — every page you visited once is cached and readable. Try a page you have already seen, or reconnect to load something new.
